resources.string:
Thank you for playing College Football Head Coach (CFHC)! 

Please share any feedback to the developer on how to improve this game! 

 v1.4 
+ New Dashboard UI 
+ Added Offensive and Defensive Coordinators 
+ New Player and Coaching Profiles 
+ Year-by-Year Stats 
+ Updated Transfers Dialogs 
+ In-Game Injuries 
+ Several game tweaks and code re-writes 
+ Ability to Cut Players 
+ Convert to Pro-Rel in Preseason 

 v1.4.33 
+ Added Coaching Age Import Feature 

 v1.4.5 
+ Expanded test coverage: box score invariants, standings, awards, depth chart, progression, transfers, recruiting, and career lifecycle 
+ Desktop theme polish and dark mode improvements 
+ Cross-platform cleanup: Android-only recruiting UI classes separated 
+ Null-safety and dead code removal across desktop and shared engine 
+ Save/load robustness improvements 

 v1.5.0 
+ Autosave: your dynasty is saved after every week, and the game picks up where you left off if Android closes it (Home → Load → Resume Autosave) 
+ Gameday Plan: set your fourth-down approach and halftime and fourth-quarter calls before kickoff 
+ Offseason Hub: a step-by-step checklist for the offseason 
+ New Team Home cards: Roster Spotlight, Locker Room (morale) and Program 
+ Tap any final score in Weekly Scores to open its box score; Mock Draft is in the drawer all year 
+ Fixed: every game now falls in one week for both teams (teams no longer play twice in a week) 
+ Fixed: loading a save no longer plays several weeks of games at once 
+ Fixed: crashes on the first Play Week of a season and at the Season Summary 
+ Refreshed lists, dialogs, rating badges and star ratings; crisper team crests and trophies 
+ Licenses screen under Credits; smaller download 
+ Updated for Android 16
